tools.name: chain-dangle-weights-20261012.json
tools.description: Inspect disconnected indexed mesh islands and explicitly map selected chain pieces to existing bones. Creates a mesh copy with rigid weights for mapped pieces while preserving topology and untouched influences; requires the correct source rig and movement checks.
requirements: Unity 2022.3; readable skinned mesh with matching bones and bind poses.
Explicit piece-to-bone mappings reviewed against the intended rig.
limitations: Source preview. The intended shoe asset has not been repaired or validated.
Indexed islands may be split by UV seams; above 256 islands the tool remains diagnostic-only.
Does not weld, compress, create bones or add physics. No scene save or upload.
